# March 31, 1950 data
max_1950 = 275000
subject_1950 = 255013
utilization_1950 = (subject_1950 / max_1950) * 100

# March 31, 1955 data

subject_1955 = 273571

print(f'March 31, 1955 utilization: {utilization_1955:.4f}%')
print(f'Mean utilization: {mean_utilization:.2f}')
print(f'Result (without % sign): {round(mean_utilization, 2)}')
"
